thread:
maria: Quick ping — I opened a small cleanup PR that splits the auth helpers into a dedicated `auth/` surface and tidies exports. Looking for style/modularization eyes and a quick API check before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4823

sam: Can someone confirm this preserves the public import paths? worried about downstream imports breaking.

maria: Good call — I left the old barrel file in place for compatibility with a deprecation comment and added tests. See the compatibility note in the PR description.

alex: I'll take a look after stand, ETA ~2pm. :eyes:

jin: CI flagged a lint failure (leftover `console.log`). can you rebase and fix?

maria: Fixed and pushed — also added a small CHANGELOG entry. PTAL @sam @alex

ci-bot: build #648 — all checks passed ✅ (lint, unit, integration). details: https://ci.redwood-inference/builds/648

sam: skimmed quickly — style looks good overall. left one nit in the PR about the rename `isAuthenticated` -> `authCheck` — that's potentially breaking for consumers. can we add an alias with a deprecation comment?

maria: Added an alias with a TODO deprecation note and an inline comment in the barrel file. Also added a tiny unit test to validate both names. Thanks for the catch.

alex: lgtm from me. :shipit: I'll merge at ~3pm unless someone objects.

maria: thanks all — I'll watch for any fallout and open a follow-up if we need a migration guide.

jin: thanks — nice and tidy refactor.

sam: cool, thanks everyone.
